summary: Comprehensive revision of the implementation plan eliminating all consumer subscription tier selectors (FREE/PRO/Enterprise) site-wide to establish an open enterprise-standard experience, resolving post-sign-in bugs with seamless enterprise session management, incorporating rich immersive motion design (canvas telemetry particles, bionic border beams, 3D card tilt, animated SVG traffic lines), adding 4 clutter-free infrastructure blueprint templates with clean minimalist prompt synthesis, providing full administrator CRUD over Verified Enterprise Track Records and homepage credentials, and overhauling mobile navigation to prevent dropdown clipping.
